title: Having a new puppy has reminded me of something related to coaching and new things.
hook: Having a new puppy has reminded me of something related to coaching and new things.
caption:
Having a new puppy has reminded me of something related to coaching and new things.

Everything new comes with some effort.

I thought I was ready for Luna, and I was. 

But being ready didn't mean I knew exactly what was gonna come up.

And coaching can feel like that too. 

You can be ready to stop people-pleasing, speak up, and set boundaries. 

And then when you actually start doing it.....

The guilt hits. The shame hits.

Someone responds differently than you hoped.

You fall back into old patterns.

That doesn't mean you weren't ready.

It means you're learning how to do something new.

title: Distance is not always rejection. Sometimes it is the cleanest way to protect love.
hook: Distance is not always rejection. Sometimes it is the cleanest way to protect love.
caption:
Distance is not always rejection. Sometimes it is the cleanest way to protect love.

You can care about someone and still stop giving them full access to your peace. You can forgive and still move differently. You can wish them well and still choose space. Real emotional discipline is knowing when closeness is creating chaos, and when distance is creating clarity.

The STFU Method starts here: quiet the guilt, honor the boundary, and protect the peace you worked so hard to build.

#JorgePerezJr #TheSTFUMethod #MindsetCoach #HealthyBoundaries #MentalClarity

title: Sometimes we become so focused on where we want to be that we forget to look behind us.
hook: Sometimes we become so focused on where we want to be that we forget to look behind us.
caption:
Sometimes we become so focused on where we want to be that we forget to look behind us.

We see the goal we haven’t reached.
The habit we haven’t completely changed.
The confidence we’re still building.
The things we still need to work on.

And it can feel like we’re getting nowhere.

But take a second and ask yourself:

Am I the same person I was a year ago?

Think about what you’ve learnt.
What you’ve overcome.
What you handle differently now.
The boundaries you’ve created.
The small decisions you’ve made that nobody else noticed.

There’s nothing wrong with wanting more for yourself.

title: 💪 “I am overweight and don’t know where to start exercising.”
hook: 💪 “I am overweight and don’t know where to start exercising.”
caption:
💪 “I am overweight and don’t know where to start exercising.”

If getting started feels confusing, remember this:

🌱 START WHERE YOU ARE. PROGRESS AT YOUR PACE.

You don’t need to jump into difficult workouts. A better approach is to begin with manageable movement, understand your current fitness level and gradually build strength, stamina and confidence.

✨ Your starting routine could include:
🚶 Walking and daily movement
🧘 Mobility and flexibility work
🏋️ Beginner-level resistance exercises
⏱️ Short, realistic workout sessions
📈 Gradual progression over time

🎯 DON’T CHASE PERFECTION. BUILD
